LIBRARY ASSISTNAT RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2022
NOTICE
No.- 19/R&A Cell Dated: 24th May, 2023
In view of the unwillingness shown by Sri Kundan Kumar (LA220803027), a
candidate from the UR-wait list to submit joining to the post of Library Assistant in the
establishment of Patna High Court, it is hereby notified that Hon’ble Court have been pleased
to cancel the offer of appointment of Sri Kundan Kumar (LA220803027).
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General I/c
